subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should this issue ship as warning-only Control UI budget visibility first, or should OpenClaw also block oversized MEMORY.md saves and design auto-archive behavior now?
rationale: Current main already has partial diagnostics, but refusing saves and moving memory content change user editing and recovery semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship warning-only first
options.body: Add Control UI budget visibility and near-limit warnings while leaving save refusal and archive behavior for separate product decisions.

options.title: Block oversized saves
options.body: Make the Control UI or agents.files.set refuse over-budget MEMORY.md saves with an explicit override and recovery path.

options.title: Design archive workflow separately
options.body: Treat auto-archive as a memory persistence feature with pointers, undo, and doctor or recovery integration before implementation.

recommendation.title: Ship warning-only first
recommendation.body: Add Control UI budget visibility and near-limit warnings while leaving save refusal and archive behavior for separate product decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway agent RPC and bootstrap-helper history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the API and product boundary choice.
